summary: Changes the IANA registration procedure for the IS-IS Neighbor Link-Attribute Bit Values registry, which RFC 5029 created, from Standards Action to Expert Review. This makes it easier to allocate new bit values. It updates RFC 5029.

eli5.summary: There is a list of special labels that routers can stick on links. Before, adding a label needed a big formal approval. Now a few experts can say yes, which is quicker.
